function.arguments: {"observation": "`customer_age` contains 108 values of exactly -1, which the documentation says means 'the customer did not supply an age'.", "implication": "These -1 values are sentinel values, not actual ages. If included in the mean, they would bias the result downward (since -1 is much lower than real ages). Therefore, they must be excluded from the mean calculation. The population should be restricted to customers with valid age data (i.e., `customer_age != -1`) who also converted."}
function.name: note_finding
